description.short_caption: Scalp with scaly, crusted, and hyperpigmented patches.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the scalp with multiple irregular, scaly, and crusted patches. The affected areas appear hyperpigmented with some areas of alopecia. The lesions are distributed unevenly and have a rough texture. The surrounding skin appears slightly erythematous. The findings suggest a dermatologic condition, possibly infectious or inflammatory in origin.
